cases.purpose: Exercise the unchanged release auth PTY comparison/clearing and fd close against the experimental real secret-slot module.
cases.oracle: Actual Linux ioctl results from the hash-bound stage-1 module, its independent C real-device control, private synthetic data, and Debian libargon2 with a known vector. A newly stored record is strict canonical unpadded-base64 PHC, independently recomputed. The storage backend is newly authored from reviewed callers; original kernel source and production policy have not been recovered. Separate KUnit execution is required for internal erasure evidence.
cases.comparison: All seccomp-notified calls continue to the real kernel. Require real authority opens and secret-slot ioctls, exact statuses and private-account results. The auth case drives three bounded PTY prompts, checks disabled echo and restoration, sealed comparisons, explicit clear and absent old handles on a fresh fd. The newly generated PHC must use canonical unpadded base64 salt/hash, exact Argon2id version/parameters, 16 salt bytes and 32 hash bytes, independently recomputed with pinned libargon2. Historical hex-input compatibility remains exercised by the unchanged initial private shadow and real verify case. The fixture loads and removes the module itself; a remaining module or node, or a new kernel diagnostic in the log between load and removal, is an incomplete observation.
cases.stdout: auth-stage1 real-device=yes compare=yes clear=yes fresh-fd=yes pty=yes
